description: Changes the settings passed and answers them all. A Rollstack report's burst takes only variantNaming. An older report's run settings, such as updateMethod, also apply to its existing variants. Only the burst's owner and admins may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

archiveVariantsInFolder.description: With `updateMethod` `archive`: whether each variant's archived copies go in an archive folder next to its file, rather than beside it. For an older report's burst only: a Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

caseInsensitiveFilters.description: Whether a variant's filter values match the dashboard's values whatever their case. It applies when filters are next applied, such as with `reapplyBurstFilters`. For an older report's burst only: a Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

datestampSuffix.description: With `updateMethod` `archive`: the date format added to the name of each archived copy. For an older report's burst only: a Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

updateMethod.description: How each variant's run changes its file. `update` updates the same file with the latest data. `archive` first saves a copy of the file, named with the date of its previous run, then updates the original. `updateVisualizations` is the method email reports are created with. It applies to new variants and to the existing ones. For an older report's burst only: a Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

variantEmptyVisualizations.description: What a variant's run does with a chart or table that has no data for its values. `show` places it empty, `hideNoCascade` leaves it out of the file, `hideCascade` hides its slide when every visualization on the slide is empty, and `hideCascadeIfAtLeastOneVisualizationIsEmpty` hides its slide when any of them is. For an older report's burst only: a Rollstack report's burst returns 400.

variantNaming.description: How each variant's report is named from the burst's name and the name the variant is added with, `EMEA` in a burst named `Regional Review`: `suffix` gives `Regional Review - EMEA`, `prefix` gives `EMEA - Regional Review`, and `sameName` gives `EMEA`. It applies to variants added from then on.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: updateBurstSettings
